adversarial.desc: Inventory does not rewrite B-12f3 history or convert previous dry-run fail-closed evidence into Authority completion.

items.title: Expose evidence result semantics in evidence_inspect JSON
items.context: F-003 found a real audit correctness gap: checklist_get preserves failed Authority proof evidence as result=fail, but evidence_inspect --format=json omits result/verdict/note, so the portable audit surface cannot mechanically see blocked proof semantics. Fix only the evidence_inspect projection and targeted smoke coverage.
items.userSees: User sees evidence_inspect --format=json entries for CHK-002:authority-proof-fail:* with result="fail", verdict="blocked_classified", and explanatory note.

happy.desc: evidence_inspect --format=json preserves result, verdict, note, and waiverType from checklist verificationEvidence refs.

edge.desc: Custom failed Authority proof refs remain visible with result=fail while lifecycle waiver refs remain distinguishable as waiver/pass.

adversarial.desc: The change does not mint receipts, alter authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone, or convert blocked proof into passing Authority proof.
